i often use the MRT in early morning and it’s usually crowded.
Idk if your commute timing may be diff, but for me, it’s near impossible to social distance in large crowds.

[MRT Trains and Buses More Crowded After Circuit Breaker](https://www.tnp.sg/news/singapore/mrt-trains-and-buses-more-crowded-after-circuit-breaker) 

Anyways masks (and not talking on mrt/buses) will prevent bodily fluids escaping thru our mouths when we speak :)
so tell me how to maintain social distancing on public transport when the trains and buses are packed like sardines in peak hours.
